feature_castAges_detail.message: Shows a living person’s current age next to their birth date. IMDb already prints the age at death for people who have died.

feature_collapsibleSections_detail.message: Adds per-section collapse controls and remembers each state.

feature_compactHeader_detail.message: Slims the IMDb header while keeping it readable and stable.

feature_dimLowRated_detail.message: Fades the artwork of titles rated below your threshold on lists, charts, and search results. Text and controls stay fully readable, and hovering restores the image.

feature_editorialTitleSurface_detail.message: Rebuilds title pages into a stable editorial hero with dedicated action, rating, and research regions.

feature_enhancedRatingDisplay_detail.message: Elevates IMDb rating and popularity blocks with clearer emphasis.

feature_episodeHeatmap_detail.message: Colours IMDb’s own season×episode grid by rating and adds season averages, on the Ratings tab of a series.

feature_episodeSubtitles_detail.message: Adds a subtitle link to every episode on an episode list, plus a button that copies them all for the loaded season.

feature_expandSummaries_detail.message: Releases IMDb’s line clamp so long summaries and biographies read in full without a per-block click.

feature_expandedLinkMenu_detail.message: Groups additional movie, review, subtitle, and TV lookup links.

feature_externalLinks_detail.message: Adds trusted research and trailer links near the title.

feature_inlineLetterboxdScore_detail.message: Shows Letterboxd average ratings inline for films when available.

feature_inlineMetacriticScore_detail.message: Shows Metacritic score feedback inline when available.

feature_inlineRTScore_detail.message: Shows Rotten Tomatoes score feedback inline when available.

feature_keyboardShortcuts_detail.message: Optional. Enables ? for settings, c to copy, r for rating, and t for top.

feature_listMultiSearch_detail.message: Builds a popup-safe queue of up to 20 title links on watchlist, list, and chart pages.

feature_listRoulette_detail.message: Adds a button to watchlists, lists, and charts that picks one title at random and scrolls to it. It never opens anything.

feature_listRuntimeSummary_detail.message: Totals how long the titles on a watchlist, list, or chart would take to watch, and says how many had no runtime listed.

feature_markFilters_detail.message: Adds an All / Unseen / Seen / Skipped filter with counts to lists, charts, watchlists, search results, and filmographies. Needs private marks.

feature_mediaServerIntegration_detail.message: Checks configured local Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby servers and shows whether the title is already in your library.

feature_modernUI_detail.message: Applies the selected theme, typography, focus, and component treatment.

feature_quickCopyID_detail.message: Adds a visible IMDb ID copy button beside the title.

feature_quickNav_detail.message: Adds a right-side section navigator on wide screens.

feature_ratingColorCoding_detail.message: Adds a small quality label beside the IMDb score.

feature_ratingGap_detail.message: On the Ratings tab, compares IMDb’s weighted rating with the unweighted mean of the raw votes.

feature_removeAds_detail.message: Hides current IMDb ad placements, sponsored shells, and tracking pixels as early as the page allows.

feature_removeAppBanner_detail.message: Hides app-install prompts shown on desktop pages.

feature_removeContribution_detail.message: Removes contribution calls to action from detail pages.

feature_removeNewsSection_detail.message: Keeps the page focused by removing IMDb news modules.

feature_removeProUpsell_detail.message: Hides explicit IMDbPro prompts and links from title and name pages while preserving list controls.

feature_removeRelatedInterests_detail.message: Hides broad interest recommendations that dilute title and cast pages.

feature_removeSponsoredRecs_detail.message: Suppresses sponsored recommendation blocks where IMDb inserts them.

feature_searchButtons_detail.message: Adds prominent, keyboard-friendly watch-site links near the title.

feature_seasonProgress_detail.message: Shows how much of the loaded season you have marked seen, links to the next unmarked episode, and marks or clears the whole loaded season in one step with an undo. Needs private marks.

feature_servarrIntegration_detail.message: Adds optional local Radarr/Sonarr quick-add buttons with library status indicator when API settings are configured.

feature_spoilerBlur_detail.message: Softens long plot text until you intentionally reveal it.

feature_streamAvailability_detail.message: Shows one-glance JustWatch streaming providers when available.

feature_subtitleLinks_detail.message: Adds subtitle lookup links in the details section.

feature_titleNotes_detail.message: Adds a private note field to title pages, saved on this device and included in backups. Never sent anywhere.

feature_trailerPopover_detail.message: Adds an in-page trailer modal backed by a click-to-fetch YouTube lookup.

feature_tvEpisodeTools_detail.message: Surfaces the highest-rated episodes; synopsis blur remains opt-in through Spoiler blur on plot.

feature_tvShowEnhancements_detail.message: Adds TV-specific lookup shortcuts on series pages.

feature_watchedMarking_detail.message: Adds private Seen and Skip marks on title cards across titles, charts, lists, watchlists, filmographies, and search results. Marks stay on this device and do not change IMDb Watched.

feature_watchlistBatch_detail.message: Adds a watchlist-page button that copies all visible IMDb title IDs.

feature_widerLayout_detail.message: Uses more horizontal room across normal desktop window sizes.

provider_tmdb_consent.message: Sends the IMDb id to TMDB to look up where the title streams. Needs your own TMDB read token.

provider_wikidata_consent.message: Sends the IMDb id to Wikidata to find the matching page on another site.

provider_youTube_consent.message: Loads the trailer from YouTube, which sees the video you opened.
